title: Export failures
body: Collect the report ID, export format, timestamp, and visible error. Try exporting a small report to isolate the scope.

title: Large report export
body: For large reports, try a shorter date range or CSV format. Preserve the original report and record whether the smaller export succeeds.

title: Login troubleshooting
body: Check the workspace URL and record the sign-in error. Ask whether password sign-in or SSO is affected. Never request passwords or recovery codes.

title: Team SSO failures
body: Ask an administrator to check identity-provider status and recent configuration changes. Collect a timestamp and request ID without collecting credentials.

title: Invoice questions
body: Collect the invoice identifier and billing period. A billing reviewer must verify charges before promising any adjustment.

title: Duplicate charge reports
body: Ask for the invoice identifiers and charge dates, excluding full card details. Refer potential duplicates to billing review; do not promise a refund.

title: Integration sync failures
body: Collect the integration name, last successful sync time, and sanitized error. Check whether authorization expired before recommending reconnection.

title: Webhook delivery
body: Collect a delivery identifier and HTTP status code. Check the receiving endpoint logs and retry policy without sharing signing secrets.

title: Support intake
body: Ask which product feature is affected, what was expected, what happened, and when the issue began.

title: Incident intake
body: Collect the number of affected users, scope of blocked work, and any workaround. Treat a suspected release regression as a hypothesis until verified.
